title: Beautiful & Spacious Modern Home in Nashville!
description:
Located in the heart of Nashville - less than 5 miles from Broadway - this beautiful, modern and spacious home provides the perfect atmosphere for a relaxing getaway in Music City.

With both a large, open living room and private upstairs loft, you can enjoy spending time inside, head to the local restaurants and bars less than a mile away, or spend time in downtown Nashville! 

This is a perfect location for all types of vacationers!

The space
You will be provided with essentials and even some comforts to make sure that you are happy with your stay.  Open concept downstairs with a beautiful and newly installed fireplace and 65 inch TV, fully functional kitchen, stainless steel appliances, two fully stocked mini refrigerators (1 downstairs and 1 in the upstairs loft), portable bluetooth speakers to enjoy music anywhere in the house and another mounted TV and couch on the second floor loft with a fully equipped wet bar.
